name: lazybird
description: Speech, voiceovers and video for AI agents: turn text or SSML into natural speech, build multi-voice voiceovers and videos with stock footage, music and on-screen text, export MP4, MP3 and SRT subtitles, share by link, clone a voice from a sample, or design one from a description. Lazybird API.

interface.shortDescription: Speech and video for AI agents
interface.longDescription:
Lazybird makes natural speech, voiceovers and videos for your agent. Through the Lazybird MCP server or the REST API, the skill teaches the model the whole workflow: find a voice (built-in, community and your own cloned voices), turn a script into MP3 speech, build voiceover projects with a voice per speaker for podcasts, dialogue and audiobooks, make video ads and explainers with free stock footage, music, on-screen text and animation, export MP4/MOV video, MP3/WAV/OGG audio and TXT/DOCX/SRT/VTT transcripts and subtitles, share a project by link, clone a voice from a short audio sample, and design a new voice from a text description.

Good for creators who need voiceovers, social videos, ads and podcast intros, and for developers adding speech or video rendering to apps, scripts and agents.

Limitations: you need a Lazybird account (sign in through the MCP server, or an API key for your own code). Each account renders a limited length of video a day. Only clone voices you have the right to use.
capabilities: Generate speech from text or SSML
Make videos with stock media and music
Export MP4, MP3 and SRT subtitles
defaultPrompt: Make a 15-second vertical video ad for my coffee shop with music and subtitles.
Turn this script into a two-voice podcast intro and export it as an MP3.
Find a deep British male narrator voice and generate a 20-second sample.

publication.release_notes: 2.0: voiceover and video projects. Multi-voice scripts, stock photos and clips, music, on-screen text and animation; export MP4/MOV, MP3/WAV/OGG and TXT/DOCX/SRT/VTT; share links; team key scopes and render limits.
